cases.prompt: There is outdoor smoke. How can I make my room cleaner if I have no purifier?
cases.check: Offer feasible actions without assuming equipment; do not claim masks or particle filters remove all gases.
cases.answer: If there's outdoor smoke and you have no air purifier, you can help reduce smoke particles in your room by closing windows and doors to limit outdoor air entry. Use a fan set to exhaust mode (carefully) to gently draw air from outside, but avoid running it continuously as it may pull more smoke indoors. Keep indoor heat and ventilation balanced—avoid over-ventilating, which can bring in more smoke.
